name: Nova Scotia Business Rebate
eligibilitySummary: Nova Scotia provincial program providing rebates to small businesses for costs related to starting up, expanding, or improving operations. Covers eligible capital costs and operational improvements.

funding.description: Rebate of up to $15,000 on eligible business costs including equipment, leasehold improvements, and technology adoption. Covers up to 25% of eligible project costs.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be a Nova Scotia-based small business with 1-100 employees and less than $5M in annual revenue. Must incur eligible costs before applying for rebate.
